evidence.snippet: Welcome to the NASA API portal. The objective of this site is to make NASA data, including imagery, eminently accessible to application developers.

evidence.claim: real signup form submitted; API key delivered by email and extracted by regex
evidence.snippet: Signup form: first name, last name, email -- no password, no login concept. Key delivered in an email with subject containing "API key", a 40-character alphanumeric token extracted by regex, matching the platform's (api_umbrella) own example key format.
